proof_scope: pre-submission adversarial gate integrity: pinned evaluator, profile contract, both campaigns green

claims.proves: the gate runs the locked Battle evaluator under the oai-trial profile and both campaigns pass; a tampered lock fails closed
claims.does_not_prove: absence of all possible anonymization defects, external-linkage resistance, or provider-driven Red quality

cases.name: tampered-lock-fails-closed
command: cd .. && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('security/battle/battle.lock.json')); d['bundle_manifest_sha256']=d['bundle_manifest_sha256'][:-4]+'beef'; json.dump(d, open('/tmp/oai-tampered-lock.json','w'))" && python3 security/battle/resolve_battle.py --lock /tmp/oai-tampered-lock.json
